Grand Final Week 2026: Everything you need to know

Author
NRL.com
Timestamp
Wed 30 Sep 2026, 06:25 PM

Share on social media

Instaread

Your complete guide for the 2026 Grand Final Week and NRL and NRLW Telstra Premiership Grand Final day at Accor Stadium.

Be part of all the excitement, drama and fun of the grand final week starting with a fan march across the iconic Sydney Harbour Bridge on Monday afternoon with events continuing all week leading up to gameday. 

In the NRL it's the Roosters taking on the Knights for the ultimate prize while the NRLW grand final sees the Roosters and Broncos square off in a mouth-watering rematch of last year's epic decider.

The Roosters have the chance to join the Broncos as the only clubs to win both the NRL and NRLW Premiership on the same day.

Here's everything you need to know about the biggest week on the rugby league calendar.

2026 Grand Final Week Launch

A bumper week of events will kick off on Monday afternoon when fans of the four competing teams take over the Harbour Bridge before heading to Campbells Cove for the official launch of Grand Final Week. 

Join your fellow fans, club mascots, NRL & NRLW legends, and club ambassadors, and get amongst the atmosphere with giveaways along the way.

All four fan groups will gather at 4.30pm.

Campbells Cove: Fans of the Roosters (NRL) and the Roosters (NRLW) sides.
Bradfield Park, Milsons Point: Fans of the Broncos (NRLW) and the Knights (NRL).

Wear your colours, bring your crew and make some noise for your team.

The event will begin with a Junior Rugby League Stars clinic at Bradfield Park at 3.00pm before the fan march at 4.30pm.

2026 NRL Fan Fest

The 2026 NRL Fan Fest will be held at Martin Place in the Sydney CBD on Thursday October 1 and Friday October 2. This is a free event suitable for all ages.

Get amongst the Grand Final Week atmosphere as fans come together to celebrate the NRL and NRLW seasons, rep their team and countdown to the Grand Final. 

Across the two days, fans can expect Grand Final team appearances, fan activations, giveaways, photo opportunities and plenty more. Plus, be there for your chance to win Grand Final Tickets! 

Thursday - 11.00am to 3.00pm
Friday - 11.00am to 3.00pm

NRL Grand Final Fan Fest is a free ticketed event. Click here for more information and to register for tickets.

Note: There is no event parking available, so we strongly encourage fans to use public transport when travelling to and from Martin Place. 

Grand Final Teams 

Thursday 12pm: Both Men’s Grand Final Teams presented on stage

12.45pm: NRL Grand Final Media Conference. Coaches and captains of Sydney Roosters and Knights.

Friday 12pm: Both Women’s Grand Final Teams presented on stage

12.45pm: NRLW Grand Final Media Conference. Coaches and captains of Roosters and Broncos.

Telstra Live Mural

Telstra is celebrating 25 years with a special live mural at Fan Fest. Watch as the artwork comes to life, featuring the Premiership trophies.

Red Bull Sampling

Red Bull will be on site throughout Fan Fest, handing out ice-cold cans to help fans stay refreshed and energised.

Shapes Sampling

The Shapes team will be handing out complimentary samples from its new Light & Crispy range for fans to try throughout the event.

Westpac's Ball Pass

Successfully pass the ball through one of the targets and you could take home an 11-inch football or a keyring.

Dare Sampling

Keep an eye out for the Dare team, who will be handing out complimentary bottles of Dare to fans throughout the event.

KFC Hot Seat

Fans selected to participate on stage will receive a $10 KFC voucher for every correct answer. Plus, KFC will hand out 150 Go Buckets each day!

Plan your ultimate Sydney itinerary

Sydney is a treasure trove of unexpected experiences and secret spots. Access insider knowledge to plan your ultimate Sydney itinerary with tips on the best accommodation, restaurants and bars, experiences and must-see events so you can feel new again.

Sydney, Australia | Official Sydney Tourism Website

NRL Grand Final Lunch 

This is the ultimate Grand Final week event leading into Sunday's thrilling end to the 2026 Rugby League season.

Join some of the biggest names in the game, as we celebrate the end of an era for the retiring class of 2026.

Hear directly from the competing Grand Final representatives and listen to a host of NRL & NRLW greats talk about the season that was, and the big games ahead of us.

Thursday 1 October, 2026 - 12:00pm to 4:00pm, International Convention Centre, 
14 Darling Drive, Sydney NSW 2000. Click here for more details and to book your seat.

Bondi Beach Footy Fest

Head to Bondi Beach on Saturday 3 October for a huge day of touch footy, music and fan experiences at Bondi Beach Footy Fest, from 8am-2pm. 

Whether you're hitting the sand with your squad or soaking up the action from the sidelines, there'll be plenty happening throughout the day, including exhibition matches with NRL legends, interactive experiences, giveaways and so much more.

Register a team for free - spots are limited, so get in quick! We've also got the little legends covered with League Stars Clinics for kids aged 5–12.

Bondi Beach Footy Fest is the place to be - don’t miss it! 

CLICK HERE to register a team

1.20pm – State Championship kick-off
4.00pm – NRLW Telstra Premiership Grand Final kick-off
7.30pm – NRL Telstra Premiership Grand Final kick-off

Transport and Travel Information

For more detailed transport info and to plan your trip head to 
Transport NSW | NRL & NRLW Grand Final 2026 

Arriving by Train

The closest station to Accor Stadium is Olympic Park. From the station, it’s a short 10-minute walk via Olympic Boulevard to the stadium. 

Travel on trains is included in your match ticket, simply show your ticket to staff when boarding services.  

Express and limited-stop trains will run to Olympic Park from Central and Western Line stations from mid-afternoon, with frequent return services until late.

Arriving by Bus

Accor Stadium is easily accessible by bus, with Sydney Buses operating a number of services to Sydney Olympic Park. 

Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run on all nine routes every 5 to 20 minutes between 1:35pm and 6:05pm depending on the route. Last return bus leaves Olympic Park at 11pm. 

NRL Grand Final Broadcast Details

Domestic TV coverage in Australia

Available via Nine and 9 Now as well as via Sky NZ in New Zealand. Radio coverage in Australia is available via ABC, Triple M Brisbane, Triple M Sydney, 2GB, 4BC and NRL Nation.

Watch Parties

Roosters Fans

Join fellow Roosters fans at the club's Official Watch Party at Easts Bondi Junction or take the family along to the Family Watch Party at Waverley Greens and experience both Grand Finals live and loud alongside the Roosters faithful.

Knights Fans

Knights fans are set to unite across Wests venues and McDonald Jones Stadium for the club’s historic NRL grand final.

With tickets to the blockbuster against the Roosters sold out, fans unable to make the trip down to Sydney can be part of the action at their local Wests venue or the free live site at the Knights’ spiritual home, McDonald Jones Stadium.

Wests venues will bring the Grand Final atmosphere to their communities, with fans encouraged to wear their red and blue, gather with family and friends, and get behind the Knights as they chase their third NRL premiership.

McDonald Jones Stadium Grand Final Live Site

Gates open: 3.30pm
Entry: Gates 2 and 3
Tickets: Free, with registration via Ticketmaster from 10am Thursday.
